items.reason: The preset's Lift field controls row lifting in the snapshot builder.
Only the shipped active preset sets Lift to true.
The pin alias sets Lift without a warning or finding.
The decoder gives lift precedence over pin.
Lift defaults to false when neither spelling is present.
With lift present, a non-bool pin value is ignored without a config finding.
The diff renames derived-ordering identifiers, comments, and test files to lift.
Manual and unrelated uses of pin remain unchanged.
The field description and shipped presets use lift; pin remains an input alias.
The repository pass lifts sets from sibling worktrees, with a test.
Checkout attribution returns before the repository pass and retains its ordering.
Task-set tags retain precedence, with a repository-backed test.
Repository candidates include both bound and unbound Task sets.
Matching uses the common directory, but row keys still use project name and container ID; identical IDs in same-named projects can lift another repository's row.
Unknown repositories and directories outside repositories produce no attribution or message.
The repository pass merges all answering kinds; a two-kind test checks this.
Launch resolves the repository once; a counting git test checks five rebuilds.
Status uses empty pane facts and does not call repository resolution for attribution.
Lifting only moves admitted rows and does not widen the preset.
Repository attribution includes live Maps and excludes broken or inactive Maps.
The merged answer places Task sets before Maps, with a test.
A Map session stamp returns before repository attribution, with a test.
Routines implement no locality pass, and a comment explains this decision.

scores.rationale: Clear separation and broad tests, but alias validation and cross-repository row identity remain incomplete.
